summary: The candidate verifies and fixes the parent review's NaN promotion and tensor terminal-state defects, and adds useful schema/resolver/trajectory primitives. It remains a partial framework: production callers never load or resolve a manifest and never pass resolved_plan to DenoisingStage, so uncovered requests are not forced eager.

tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced absence of the requested feature at the recorded base via ModuleNotFoundError.
NaN checkpoint and output metrics both passed; equal tensor-valued terminal mappings raised RuntimeError.
Exact candidate rejects both NaN cases and handles tensor terminal mappings; unsupported threshold metric name raises KeyError rather than rejecting cleanly.

tests.command: rg -n '_maybe_torch_compile\(' python/sglang/multimodal_gen --glob '!**/test/**' and symbol audit for CompilePlanResolver/CompiledPlanManifest
tests.what_was_measured: All production compile callers omit resolved_plan; resolver/manifest construction and request workload-signature derivation have no production consumer.
Real ROCm Inductor execution on MI350X/gfx950: four-step toy trajectory parity, reset/short-history, and intentional perturbation rejection; max absolute error 1.1920928955078125e-07.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. Candidate toy trajectory compiled and executed with Inductor. This is not production-model semantic evidence.

remaining_counterexamples: No production server/configuration/request path constructs CompilePlanResolver, derives CompileWorkloadSignature, loads a manifest, or passes resolved_plan to DenoisingStage; uncovered production requests therefore are not forced eager.
All real _maybe_torch_compile call sites omit resolved_plan, so the new safety branch is reachable only through direct tests or hypothetical future callers.
A gate declaring an unsupported tensor metric name raises KeyError rather than producing a fail-closed rejected promotion.
No real diffusion or stateful world-model trajectory qualifies history regimes, cache on/off, CFG serial/parallel, reset isolation, mutation/alias metadata, or semantic output metrics.
remaining_limitations: No production diffusion/world-model weights were available.
The GPU validation used a deterministic Linear/tanh toy, not a supported production architecture or public/task-level semantic metric.
Only one AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 GPU was exercised; distributed behavior was not tested.
No native files changed and repository-environment.json declares native=null, so native rebuilding was not applicable.
Torch emitted non-fatal Dynamo metrics serialization errors during compilation.
